# Content provenance and framework references

Source-review context: September 7, 2026. A source description establishes what its document says, not independent execution, security, model quality or production performance. Branch URLs can change after review. User-supplied prior research is not treated as a substitute for retrieved source.

## Project sources

The canonical `lib/content.ts` records retain URL, purpose and scope, and visible pages include source links.

- ABI README: https://github.com/donaldfilimon/abi/blob/main/README.md — retrieved source describes the nightly Rust rewrite, local orchestration, WDBX relationship, wrapper commands, synthetic dashboard, conditional acceleration, and browser-planning limitation. No ABI tests were executed here.
- Gama README: https://github.com/donaldfilimon/gama/blob/main/README.md — retrieved source describes a modular Swift framework, scenes, retained rendering and integration modules. No platform acceptance was reproduced here.
- Existing MLAI platform and web README: pinned references in `INTEGRATION.md`; used to correct the audit’s greenfield assertion and preserve app/verification boundaries.
- Abbey identity specification: https://github.com/donaldfilimon/abi/blob/main/docs/spec/abbey-core-identity.mdx — further reading linked by the ABI README; not separately audited here.
- WDBX specification: https://github.com/donaldfilimon/abi/blob/main/docs/spec/wdbx-north-star.mdx — further reading, not an independently verified API or scale guarantee.
- External claims audit: https://github.com/donaldfilimon/abi/blob/main/docs/contracts/external-claims-audit.mdx — further reading supporting a disciplined evidence policy; not a certification.

The site excludes unverified star/commit/follower counts, legal incorporation details, performance figures, customer logos, testimonials, production security guarantees and package-version rankings. Repository descriptions and test reports remain explicitly attributed.

## Framework candidate references

- Next installation: https://nextjs.org/docs/app/getting-started/installation
- React registry metadata observed during this task: https://registry.npmjs.org/react/latest
- Next registry metadata observed during this task: https://registry.npmjs.org/next/latest
- Fumadocs manual Next integration: https://www.fumadocs.dev/docs/manual-installation/next
- Fumadocs releases: https://github.com/fuma-nama/fumadocs/releases

Next 16.3.4 and React 19.2.8 were observed in the fetched package metadata. Fumadocs ranges are candidate constraints from observed upstream releases, not a claim to have resolved the newest compatible lockfile. Exact version compatibility and security must be checked at installation. No dependency files, library source, proprietary fonts, or third-party assets are vendored in this package.
